output.summary: A perennial ginger native to East Asia, it grows in upright evergreen clumps from underground stems. Its funnel-shaped flowers are white or pink with yellow centres marked by red spots and stripes; the leaves are used to wrap and flavour foods and make herbal tea.
output.edibilityNote: Leaves are used to wrap zongzi and muchi, flavour Okinawan noodles, and make herbal tea.
